spec.title: Loki dataobj SQL: query-in-place cost and speed
spec.description: Cost ($/GB, $/query drivers) and speed (MB/s per core, latency) of the Arrow Flight + DataFusion query-in-place prototype, next to the live Loki query path in the same cell.

options.content: **Query-in-place cost model.** `cost = CPU-s × $/vCPU-h + object-store requests × $/1k + bytes × $/GB egress`. To first order the cost of a query is linear in compressed bytes scanned and independent of speed; speed (MB/s per core) sets how many cores a latency target needs, i.e. fleet size. Rows 1 and 2 read the Flight scan service's `loki_dataobj_flight_*` series for **$job** and are empty until the shadow deployment runs. Row 3 reads the live Loki query path in **$namespace** today so the two can be compared on the same axes. Prices are the `cpu_price` and `get_price` variables. Numbers are per-process rates, so run one query at a time on the shadow pod, or read them as averages.

panels.title: CPU usage — Flight scan service (cores, total)
Memory usage — Flight scan service (RSS, total)
CPU usage per pod — Flight scan service (cores)
Memory usage per pod — Flight scan service (RSS)

Bytes throughput per query — live queriers
panels.description: Same panel as 'Bytes Throughput Querier' on the Loki / Queries dashboard, pointed at this cell's queriers: distribution of bytes processed per second per query (recording rules over loki_logql_querystats_bytes_processed_per_seconds). Uncompressed bytes.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.01, sum by (le, type, range) (job_type_range:loki_logql_querystats_bytes_processed_per_seconds_bucket:sum_rate{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$querier_job"}))

panels.title: Bytes throughput — Flight scan service
panels.description: Fleet decode rate of the shadow Flight pods. The service has no per-query histogram yet; while one query runs at a time (how the harness measures) this IS that query's bytes throughput, so read it against the live panel's percentiles. 'per busy core' divides by the cores in use so the two sides can be compared at equal CPU.

targets.legendFormat: Arrow bytes served to gateway / s

panels.title: Bytes throughput per query heatmap — live queriers
panels.description: Same as 'Bytes Throughput Querier' heatmap (panel 18) on the Loki / Queries dashboard, for this cell.

panels.title: Bytes throughput per pod — Flight scan service
panels.description: The same rate split by replica (stacked): shows how evenly the ring spreads a query across the pool.

panels.title: Query latency — live path (query-frontend)
panels.description: End-to-end LogQL request latency at the query-frontend: planning, splitting, every sub-query, merge.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, route) (rate(loki_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job=~"$frontend_job", route=~"loki_api_v1_query|loki_api_v1_query_range"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, route) (rate(loki_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job=~"$frontend_job", route=~"loki_api_v1_query|loki_api_v1_query_range"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Query latency — SQL gateway (per statement)
panels.description: The SQL counterpart of the frontend panel: one observation per statement on dataobj-sql, from parse to the last result row (planning, every Flight DoGet the plan fans out into, and DataFusion's sort/join/aggregate). kind=query are data queries, kind=catalog Grafana's schema probes. 'Scan duration per endpoint' below is per ticket, thousands of which make up one statement, so it is not latency. Needs a gateway image with --metrics-addr.

panels.title: $ / compressed GB
panels.description: Marginal cost of scanning the archive: (CPU + GET spend per second) / (compressed bytes fetched per second). Speed-independent to first order.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])) * $cpu_price / 3600 + sum(rate(loki_objstore_bucket_operations_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job="$job", operation=~"get|get_range|iter|attributes"}[$__rate_interval])) * $get_price / 1000) / (sum(rate(loki_dataobj_flight_archive_compressed_bytes_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e9 > 0)

panels.title: $ / uncompressed GB
panels.description: Same spend divided by the uncompressed bytes decoded, the unit the live Loki path reports (bytes processed). Compare with the baseline row.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])) * $cpu_price / 3600 + sum(rate(loki_objstore_bucket_operations_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job="$job", operation=~"get|get_range|iter|attributes"}[$__rate_interval])) * $get_price / 1000) / (sum(rate(loki_dataobj_flight_archive_uncompressed_bytes_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e9 > 0)

panels.title: $ / hour scanning
panels.description: Spend rate of this process at the configured prices while it is busy.

panels.title: CPU-s / compressed GB
panels.description: Locally ~190 for the row-oriented archive (every record in the window is decoded, whatever the query shape).

panels.title: CPU-s / uncompressed GB
panels.description: CPU seconds per GB of decoded archive data; the live path measured ~62 CPU-s per GB processed on 2026-10-02.

panels.title: CPU cores busy
panels.description: Average cores busy over the dashboard range. CPU-s / wall-s of a query is how many cores it actually used.

panels.title: Bytes scanned / s
panels.description: For archive_logs cost follows compressed bytes fetched. For logs (data objects) it follows Arrow bytes served, since objects are read by column and page.

panels.title: Object-store requests / s
panels.description: Loki registers one shared objstore counter per process (empty bucket label), so data-object and archive GETs are summed. 'archive objects fetched' isolates the archive side.

panels.title: Cost rate by driver ($/h)
panels.description: Which lever matters. With ~2.5 KB archive objects, GET fees were expected to be the same order as CPU.

panels.title: Mean archive object size
panels.description: Small objects mean cost is driven by request count, not bytes. Batching objects is the lever.

panels.title: Throughput per core
panels.description: Decode rate per core. Locally ~5 MB/s compressed, ~37 MB/s uncompressed. Cores needed = (bytes in window) / (this × target seconds).

panels.title: Scan duration per endpoint (DoGet)
panels.description: Open to last batch for one ticket. The gateway runs tickets in parallel, so query wall time ≈ max over tickets plus gateway work.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, table) (rate(loki_dataobj_flight_scan_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, table) (rate(loki_dataobj_flight_scan_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Planning
panels.description: Fixed per-query overhead: metastore lookup or archive listing. ~25 ms locally; dominates only for windows under a few minutes.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, table) (rate(loki_dataobj_flight_plan_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Tickets per plan
panels.description: Parallelism available to the gateway: sections for data objects, object bundles for the archive.

targets.expr: sum by (table) (rate(loki_dataobj_flight_planned_tickets_sum{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (table) (rate(loki_dataobj_flight_planned_tickets_count{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Archive time split: decode vs fetch
panels.description: If fetch dominates, add concurrency; if decode dominates, the per-core rate is the ceiling.

targets.expr: sum(rate(loki_dataobj_flight_archive_decode_duration_seconds_sum{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(loki_dataobj_flight_archive_decode_duration_seconds_sum{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(loki_dataobj_flight_archive_fetch_duration_seconds_sum{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum(rate(loki_dataobj_flight_archive_fetch_duration_seconds_sum{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum(rate(loki_dataobj_flight_archive_decode_duration_seconds_sum{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(loki_dataobj_flight_archive_fetch_duration_seconds_sum{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Rows and records / s
panels.description: decoded ≫ matched means the archive layout forces decoding of records the predicate later drops.

panels.title: Scans in flight per pod
panels.description: Concurrent DoGet scans per replica, bounded by -dataobj-flight.max-concurrent-scans. The gateway's --max-partitions bounds the total per query.

panels.title: Scan queue wait
panels.description: Time a DoGet waited for a scan slot. Sustained waits mean the servers, not the gateway, are the bottleneck: add replicas or slots.

panels.title: Disk cache
panels.description: Read-through disk cache of object store reads (-dataobj-flight.disk-cache.dir). A warm run of the same query is all hits: its CPU is the decode cost with no object store traffic.

panels.title: Baseline — live Loki query path in $namespace (queriers $querier_job, frontends $frontend_job)
Baseline $ per GB processed (uncompressed)
panels.description: Querier CPU + GET spend over LogQL bytes processed as recorded by the query-frontend (queriers also record it; counting both would double it). LogQL reports uncompressed bytes, the Flight row reports compressed: compare against the uncompressed line in 'Bytes scanned'. Includes queries answered from ingesters and caches, so it is a floor for the store path.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job=~"$querier_job"}[$__rate_interval])) * $cpu_price / 3600 + sum(rate(loki_objstore_bucket_operations_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job=~"$querier_job", operation=~"get|get_range|iter|attributes"}[$__rate_interval])) * $get_price / 1000) / (sum(rate(loki_logql_querystats_bytes_processed_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job=~"$frontend_job"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e9)

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, route) (rate(loki_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job=~"$frontend_job", route=~"loki_api_v1_query|loki_api_v1_query_range"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, route) (rate(loki_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", job=~"$frontend_job", route=~"loki_api_v1_query|loki_api_v1_query_range"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Per-query throughput distribution (LogQL)
panels.description: What a LogQL query achieves end to end today (uncompressed bytes). The Flight equivalent is 'Throughput per core' × cores used.
